lessons.goal: 整合導覽使用方式、替代閱讀及路線安全條件。

lessons.story:
OLD STREET AUDIO WALK: Explore six marked stops with short recordings about local shops and buildings. You may follow the stops in any order. Scan the code on each marker; downloading all recordings at the visitor desk before starting is another option.

The complete walk takes about forty minutes, including listening and walking. If you have less time, choose individual stops. A printed transcript is available free at the desk and contains the same stories. Bringing headphones is recommended, but listening aloud near homes is not allowed.

Stop 4 stands across a busy road. Use the marked crossing even if another route looks shorter. The recording is designed to be heard while standing beside the marker, not while crossing.

The visitor desk closes at five, but the outdoor markers remain accessible. Borrowed audio players must be returned by 4:45. Visitors using their own phones and downloaded recordings may finish later. Please respect residents and keep doorways clear throughout your visit.
lessons.title: Listen to the Old Street
